verdict.rationale: Milvus documents full-text search that turns raw text into sparse embeddings, plus multi-vector search that runs several ANN searches at once. Its Lite docs list sparse and dense vector search and `hybrid_search` as shared API features, and a community comment cites hybrid search and sparse vectors as Milvus strengths. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the fusion/reranking strategy (e.g. RRF or weighted scoring), explicit confirmation that the sparse signal is BM25, and hands-on corroboration of a combined dense+sparse hybrid query.
